text:
Shuffle diagnostics have published precedent: [Does It Look Sequential?](https://github.com/Antondfger/Does-It-Look-Sequential/) compares original versus shuffled histories using HR@10, NDCG@10 and recommendation overlap. For this task, useful additional controls are last-item-preserving shuffles and recent-block deletion versus equally sized random deletions, with both deletion conditions preserving the last item. These are proposed controls, not established causal tests. Repeat perturbations across seeds and report paired user-level differences; a larger recent-deletion effect suggests dependence on recent content, while a shuffle effect with the final item fixed suggests sensitivity to earlier ordering.

Positional confounding needs explicit treatment: [SASRec’s implementation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kang205/SASRec/master/model.py) adds absolute positional embeddings and uses causal attention. Compacting a deleted history changes retained items’ positions; masking items in place changes attention visibility. Compare both with correct padding masks and a fixed prediction position. Training-prefix replay measures fit to supervised transitions, so strong replay performance alone cannot establish generalization or memorization. Compare replay diagnostics against untouched validation transitions, stratifying by history length and whether the target previously appeared; interpret the gap cautiously.

Freeze validation users, targets, candidate IDs, candidate order and tie-breaking across perturbations. Preserve the host’s 99 unique negatives and repeated-target eligibility; never regenerate negatives from perturbed histories or remove a legitimate repeated positive through seen-item filtering. Report repeat-target and novel-target strata alongside unchanged macro HR@10. [Krichene and Rendle](https://ijcai.org/proceedings/2021/651) show sampled metrics can reverse model rankings relative to full-catalog evaluation: fixed candidates support controlled comparisons within this benchmark, but do not establish full-catalog ranking quality.
